reason: Fails the value lens: measured near-no-op on our own base, and structurally a closed relink-class change. (1) Mechanism: in x138, motion_relink_edges (x138 cell 5) is a per-frame GLOBAL Hungarian on flow-compensated distance (median K12 R40; tight 7 um, relaxed 10 um; cost motion - 1.0*prob) and its edges REPLACE all ILP edges. So every track end already had every target within 7 um of p+flow offered to a global optimum. RE-AIM's local re-solve is a sub-problem of that. With a 2 um margin it can fire only where later stages (linefit, gapfill, division-geometry filter) shifted its inputs, so it is the closed relink-knob class in disguise (probe 22: -0.002). Corwin's DF_m2 was measured on a world whose flow came from ILP links (different base) and does not transfer. (2) Measured, reproduced by me: apply_reaim on the 4 dummy train-twin CSVs gives x138 1,089 proposals, 1 applied; K2 1,097 proposals, 2 applied (even at margin 0 only 9 and 8), 121k nodes unchanged, ~15 s. lens_mine-old (notes l.20) matched the 2 K2 re-points to GT: TP 2,047 / FN 80, identical, so the delta is exactly 0. (3) Ceiling from the metric: node term 0 by construction. Division term 0, since any fork freezes the local problem and it never creates or breaks one. Edge term: ~0.5 edge changes per clip against ~530 GT edges per clip, with GT covering ~2% of predicted edges (FP counts only when both ends are GT-matched), gives E[dJ] ~ 2e-5, far below the +0.001 lab gate and the +0.002 R4 bar. The FN class it targets (frag_one_free, 23% of FN) has the missing link at 6.2 um against an incumbent at 1.6 um. A geometric re-solve cannot prefer it, and old l6 evidence says single re-points are net harmful (-157 TP / +264 FP). A lab arm could only show noise, and on the private set it would be the same no-op.
fix: Do not build --patch reaim and do not add an exp60 arm or an LB slot. Record in CONTEXT that RE-AIM is closed on x138/K2: measured 1-2 applied re-points on 4 dummy clips, 0 GT change; it duplicates x138's global flow relink. Credit the check to scratchpad reaim_value/ plus lens_mine-old.notes.md. If anyone reopens it, the only admissible route is a CPU replay on exp60 final CSVs, killed if applied < 1 per clip or CONFIRMATION < +0.001 on both embryos. Move the 3-4 h to the K3/K3b decision.
realistic_gain: ~0 (E ~ +0.00002 edge J; node term 0, division term 0). Upper bound under optimistic assumptions: < +0.0005 public/private, not measurable against LB rounding; downside risk small but nonzero (relink-class re-points historically net harmful).
